corrected_text: (C3) The Swift wrapper Agello vendors (main's swift/ at 82b05ea1, Agello a691212) carries our Swift changes: failed tool calls answered with an error response; a stream holding its conversation weakly; streams kept by ID, ending once, with cancellation and bounded tool rounds; tokenize/countTokens, the embedding input overflow and its activation type; Swift 6 language mode. At Agello a691212, Vendor/README.md listed five Swift patches and CLAUDE.md said five, while the README's 'Vendored LiteRT-LM' section and the agello-litert-update skill said four, and Vendor/README.md's fifth said ExperimentalFlags keeps its values behind a Mutex, which fork 82b05ea1 had replaced with an NSLock; Agello f51fe1d (2026-11-18) brought all four to five patches and the NSLock, and Vendor/README.md now names swift/ at 82b05ea1 beside the release's binary. In October 2026 the drift was CLAUDE.md saying 'v0.18.0 plus one tool-call patch' while the wrapper carried two.
